title: OLEANDER Building Acoustics Professional Process v1.0
purpose: Run bounded building-acoustics development from use/source-receiver and criteria basis through room acoustics, separation/flanking, building-services noise/vibration, critical details, method-bound verification, delivery readback and in-use return while preserving Architecture, MEP, Structural, FLS, Knowledge and R-F authority boundaries.
scope_in: acoustic appointment, use/task/source-receiver basis and claim ceiling
room acoustics and spatial sound-field design where triggered
airborne and impact sound separation and flanking-path control
facade/environmental noise interface where in appointment
building-services noise and vibration acoustic interfaces
acoustic assemblies, junctions, penetrations, doors, glazing and finishes
acoustic prediction/modeling where appropriate and bounded
laboratory/system evidence and field measurement/commissioning where required
occupied performance, complaints, diagnostics and change return
scope_out: automatic MEP or Structural Engineering approval
automatic electroacoustic system approval outside appointment
automatic field truth from model, product rating or one field sample
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, R-F Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project jurisdiction/brief/appointment, responsible acoustic professionals and applicable statutory/licensed authorities.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on room acoustics, speech/music/privacy, airborne or impact sound isolation, facade/environmental noise, building-services noise/vibration, acoustic details, verification measurements or in-use acoustic performance.
design_question_types: use, task, source-receiver and acoustic criteria basis
responsibility_triggers: acoustic performance materially controls room geometry, adjacency, construction or equipment coordination
a specialist acoustic appointment, code/brief requirement or verification route is triggered
laboratory product/system data requires project-configuration transfer
MEP, Structure, Facade, Interior or FLS interfaces materially affect the acoustic claim
field measurement or commissioning is required
complaint, operational change or failed test contradicts design assumptions
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable valid boundary across project use/task, criteria/source applicability, exact source-receiver/system configuration, analysis method, interface maturity, construction state, field-measurement scope and responsible professional/statutory authority governs each acoustic claim.
not_triggered_when: an acoustic precedent or material is referenced without a project acoustic claim
a product page is catalogued as Knowledge evidence without project design use
mandatory_reopen_triggers: use, occupancy, room task or operating state changes
criteria, standard/method/version or acceptance route changes
room geometry, adjacency or openings change
partition, floor, ceiling, door, glazing, facade or acoustic-finish system changes
MEP source, routing, terminal, control state or vibration-support changes
penetration, seal, access panel or service coordination changes
failed measurement/test, complaint, repair or in-use evidence contradicts assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential acoustic standards, project criteria, product/system evidence, model methods, source data, field measurements and site/in-use evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional acoustic decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER Professional Domain Process and Design Quality contracts
failure-seeking for flanking, penetrations, services and workmanship
source_routes: applicable project acoustic codes, brief and specialist criteria
ISO 3382-2:2008 for reverberation-time measurement in ordinary rooms where applicable
ISO 16283-1:2014 plus applicable amendment for field airborne sound-insulation measurement where applicable
ISO 717-1:2020 for airborne sound-insulation rating context
Institute of Acoustics Building Acoustics professional context
evidence_routes: project assembly/junction and product configuration evidence
field acoustic measurements and commissioning records
construction QA, complaint, diagnostic and in-use evidence
standard_code_routes: project-applicable room-acoustic, sound-insulation, impact-sound, facade-noise, equipment-noise and vibration standards after exact applicability review
precedent_case_routes: bounded comparable acoustic designs with explicit room, source, construction, method, measurement and transfer limits
practice_routes: field verification, construction QA and defect diagnosis
tool_knowledge_routes: acoustic simulation and measurement-processing tools only with declared method/version/input/state and claim boundaries

stages.professional_question: What acoustic outcome is in scope for which users/tasks, sources, receiving spaces and operating states under which method and acceptance basis?
entry_conditions: project and acoustic decision object identified
knowledge_inputs: applicable acoustic standards and professional methods
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential criteria, source and method claims require task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Interior, MEP, Structure, Facade, FLS, FM and user/task interfaces identified
human_experience_consequences: speech, privacy, rest, concentration, music, healthcare or other acoustic task consequences are explicit where relevant
design_language_consequences: architectural/material intent is an input and cannot replace acoustic criteria/method evidence
technical_consequences: metric, method, frequency/state assumptions and claim ceiling are explicit
content_projection_requirements: distinguish code/client/specialist criteria, prediction basis and verification route
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review required for promotion-relevant adoption.
open_items_allowed: later detailed assemblies, modeling and field verification may remain open if outside current claim
exit_conditions: use/task/source-receiver basis, criteria/method and claim ceiling are explicit
reopen_triggers: use/task, criteria, source, receiver, method or authority change

stages.stage_name: Room Acoustics / Speech / Music / Spatial Sound Field
stages.professional_question: Does the room-acoustic strategy support the declared task without reducing performance to one reverberation number or material absorption value?
entry_conditions: acoustic basis sufficiently resolved for affected rooms
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Model methods, acoustic material/system data and consequential assumptions require Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Interior, MEP, Lighting/AV and occupancy assumptions coordinated
human_experience_consequences: speech intelligibility, privacy, music, comfort or task-specific acoustic consequences are represented where in claim
design_language_consequences: surface geometry/material intent is reconciled with acoustic role without treating appearance as acoustic proof
technical_consequences: frequency dependence, spatial variation and occupancy/source-state assumptions remain explicit
content_projection_requirements: show source/receiver/surface roles and distinguish model prediction from target and field evidence
required_readback: representative room acoustic geometry/model input readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted consequential acoustic-process claims.
open_items_allowed: field measurement may remain open if current claim is design/prediction only
exit_conditions: room strategy is coherent for the declared task and claim ceiling
reopen_triggers: room geometry, use, occupancy/furnishing, surface, opening, MEP or AV change

stages.professional_question: Is source-to-receiver separation resolved as a complete project assembly and junction system rather than isolated element ratings?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Ratings, lab evidence, field methods and project assembly data require exact-scope Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Interior, Structure, Facade, MEP and FLS junction/penetration interfaces coordinated
human_experience_consequences: privacy, speech transfer, sleep/rest and activity interference consequences are identified where relevant
design_language_consequences: doors/glazing/ceilings/partitions and visible junctions preserve required acoustic continuity
technical_consequences: lab element rating, project assembly, flanking and field performance remain distinct
content_projection_requirements: plans/details identify source-receiver pair, assembly and critical flanking/penetration routes
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant adoption.
open_items_allowed: field sound-insulation measurement may remain later evidence if explicit
exit_conditions: in-claim separation strategy has no unresolved critical path contradiction
reopen_triggers: adjacency, partition/floor/ceiling, door/glazing, facade, penetration or junction change

stages.stage_name: Building Services Noise / Vibration / Structure-borne Interfaces
stages.professional_question: Are equipment and service noise/vibration sources coordinated with criteria through traceable airborne, duct-borne and structure-borne paths?
entry_conditions: acoustic criteria and relevant equipment/service sources identified
required_inputs: MEP/equipment source data and operating states
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Equipment/source and isolation evidence requires exact operating/configuration Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: MEP and Structural ownership retained for equipment/system/support engineering
human_experience_consequences: background noise, tonality, intermittency and vibration consequences are represented where material
design_language_consequences: noise-control elements are coordinated with spatial/ceiling/finish intent without hiding technical requirements
technical_consequences: source, path, receiver, control state and operating condition remain traceable
content_projection_requirements: identify source/path/receiver and open MEP/structural assumptions
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted acoustic process; MEP/Structural authority remains separate.
open_items_allowed: equipment selection/field operation verification may remain open if owned and claim bounded
exit_conditions: in-claim noise/vibration acoustic interfaces are coordinated without hidden critical contradiction
reopen_triggers: equipment/source, routing, operating mode, support, isolator, duct/pipe or terminal change

stages.stage_name: Critical Acoustic Assemblies / Junctions / Penetrations / Installation Detail
stages.professional_question: Do representative critical details preserve acoustic performance through complete assemblies, junctions, penetrations, seals and buildability conditions?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential product/system/detail evidence requires exact-configuration Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Interior, MEP, Structure, Facade and FLS detail interfaces coordinated
human_experience_consequences: operability/access and acoustic privacy/comfort consequences remain explicit
design_language_consequences: visible joint/door/ceiling/material design intent is resolved at construction-readable acoustic detail level
technical_consequences: gaps, seals, resilient layers, penetrations, junctions and workmanship dependencies are traceable
content_projection_requirements: native/editable project details identify complete acoustic path and unresolved evidence
required_readback: critical project acoustic detail and installation readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant process adoption.
open_items_allowed: later construction inspection/field measurement may remain open if current claim is design detail only
exit_conditions: critical in-claim details have no unresolved acoustic-path contradiction
reopen_triggers: assembly, door/glazing, penetration, seal, finish, resilient layer, service or tolerance change

stages.professional_question: Does verification evidence actually measure or model the declared claim under a traceable method, state and configuration?
entry_conditions: verification claim, configuration and method are identified
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Methods, inputs, calibration/instrument and configuration evidence require task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: affected room/MEP/structure/facade/interior states are frozen or recorded for verification
human_experience_consequences: measurement/model conditions are related to the intended occupied task without equating one with the other
design_language_consequences: visual mock-up or presentation quality is not treated as acoustic verification
technical_consequences: method/edition, state, positions, frequency treatment, corrections, uncertainty, failure/repair/retest and transfer limits remain traceable
content_projection_requirements: results distinguish prediction, lab evidence, field measurement and occupied/in-use claims
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted process; test/measurement authority remains method/appointment specific.
open_items_allowed: production/whole-building/in-use performance remains outside sampled evidence unless separately verified
exit_conditions: required verification has bounded result and method/configuration limitations are explicit
reopen_triggers: method, configuration, room/equipment state, acceptance, repair or transfer assumption change

stages.professional_question: Does delivered construction preserve the acoustic assemblies and paths actually designed and reviewed?
entry_conditions: bounded acoustic design/verification basis exists for current delivery claim
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential submittal/product/site evidence requires exact-scope Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Interior, MEP, Structure, Facade and FLS changes reconciled through R-F
human_experience_consequences: privacy, speech, rest, background-noise and vibration defects are surfaced where observed
design_language_consequences: substitution/site detail change cannot silently alter approved spatial/material intent or acoustic path
technical_consequences: concealed continuity, seals, penetrations, resilient systems, source control and deviations are traceable
content_projection_requirements: delivery records distinguish submittal review, site inspection, field measurement and repair/retest
required_readback: construction deviation and sampled field readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant process adoption; unobserved field scope remains outside evidence.
open_items_allowed: unobserved/unmeasured areas remain outside claim and cannot inherit sample PASS
exit_conditions: bounded delivery evidence and unresolved acoustic deviations are explicit
reopen_triggers: submittal, substitution, workmanship deviation, late service change, failed inspection/test or repair

stages.stage_name: Occupied Performance / Complaint / Diagnostic / Change Return
stages.professional_question: What acoustic condition is supportable in real use, and what observations require diagnosis or reopen rather than immediate causal claims?
entry_conditions: occupied/operating evidence, measurement or complaint exists
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential in-use evidence requires task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before reuse beyond the project.
interface_requirements: FM and affected Architecture/Interior/MEP/Structure/Facade owners receive material acoustic change/readback
human_experience_consequences: complaints and experienced conditions are preserved as evidence without converting perception directly into causal diagnosis
design_language_consequences: repair/change can preserve or revise design intent only with technical acoustic compatibility
technical_consequences: observation, measurement, hypothesis, intervention and post-change verification remain separate
content_projection_requirements: in-use returns distinguish symptom, measured state, candidate cause and verified outcome
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant adoption or reusable knowledge transfer, not for every complaint record.
open_items_allowed: unknown source/path/cause or unmeasured areas remain OPEN and cap the claim
exit_conditions: current bounded acoustic in-use state and reopen items are explicit
reopen_triggers: use, room, finish, partition, door, equipment, routing, operation, repair or measured-condition change

inputs_from_domains: Architecture room geometry, adjacency, openings and spatial use
Interior partitions, finishes, ceilings, doors, furniture and operable elements
MEP source data, duct/pipe routing, terminals, controls and vibration interfaces
FLS fire-rated partitions/doors/penetrations and life-safety devices
AV/Lighting/Digital ceiling/wall penetrations and sound-system interfaces
FM operational states, maintenance and complaints
outputs_to_domains: source-receiver acoustic criteria and task consequences
controlling_authority_requirements: Architecture/Interior retain design authority for their owned scope
MEP and Structural retain engineering authority for equipment/system/support scope
project jurisdiction and responsible licensed professionals retain statutory/sign-off authority
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Building Acoustics may declare required interface maturity but may not self-award R-F closure; actual interface maturity/disposition remains with the Integration owner.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: open item is outside current claim or later verification stage
required current interface maturity is already met
open owner and reopen trigger are explicit
integration_readback_requirements: critical shared variables and actual source stage/artifact remain traceable
material acoustic change reopens affected R-F interfaces
Acoustic process PASS never substitutes for R-F Integration PASS

required_native_outputs: editable acoustic plans/details/model/configuration registers as appropriate
room/separation/noise-vibration analysis outputs at declared claim ceiling
site QA/deviation/in-use records where in claim
native_source_of_truth_rules: native editable geometry/details/models/calculations/registers and actual measurement files/records outrank presentation images
product imagery or generic detail cannot replace project acoustic-path definition
measurement result identity must resolve to exact room/system state, method and configuration
execution_owner_requirements: named Building Acoustics professional owner for acoustic decisions
R-F owner for cross-disciplinary interface state
responsible statutory/licensed owners where approval/sign-off is required
required_capabilities: construction/in-use diagnostic reconciliation where in claim
tool_adapter_requirements: AI/generated imagery cannot serve as acoustic evidence
simulation and measurement-processing outputs retain claim ceiling and limitations
actual_readback_requirements: construction/in-use deviation and repair/retest readback where applicable

assurance.professional_review: Professional review must address use/task/source-receiver basis, criteria/method applicability, exact room/assembly/system configuration, model/measurement limits, interfaces, open items and claim ceiling; artifact existence is not professional quality.
assurance.evidence_review: Evidence review must distinguish material/product data, laboratory element/system evidence, project assembly/junction, prediction, sampled field measurement and occupied/in-use evidence.
technical_gates: MEP noise/vibration and structure-borne interface coherence
assurance.independent_review: Independent Professional Domain review is required before promotion-relevant adoption; reviewer competence, authorization and independence must be explicit and producer self-check does not count.
assurance.receipt_contract: A professional receipt may record only the actually reviewed acoustic claim ceiling, exact process/inputs/readbacks, open items, verdict and stale/reopen conditions; it does not award other-domain or statutory authority.

reopen_triggers: failed measurement/test, complaint, repair or operational change
stale_scope_rules: mark only affected stage/evidence/interface scope stale where dependencies can be bounded
propagate stale state downstream when a prior acoustic basis/configuration is materially invalidated
upstream_impact_rules: field/in-use failure may reopen criteria, model assumptions, assembly choice or source-path diagnosis when causally relevant
later evidence cannot silently rewrite historical receipts
downstream_impact_rules: basis/geometry/assembly/source change propagates to affected details, models, measurements, site QA and in-use records
changed shared variable reopens dependent R-F interfaces
interface_reopen_rules: Acoustics cannot self-close reopened R-F interfaces
material change must identify affected domains/shared variables and verification scope
receipt_stale_rules: receipt becomes stale only for affected claim scope when a bound assumption/configuration/readback is invalidated
successor receipt preserves predecessor identity and reason

process_exit_conditions: required native outputs exist for declared claim ceiling
consequential Knowledge mounts are valid for exact claims
required critical interfaces meet current R-F requirements or remain explicitly outside claim
required models/tests/measurements/readbacks exist at declared evidence level
material open items do not contradict the claim
professional review is complete and exact
Independent Review is complete where adoption/promotion requires it
truthful professional receipt exists for a closed process instance
open_items_allowed: later field/occupied verification when outside current design claim
formal statutory approval when explicitly outside current professional claim
unknown/unmeasured rooms or operating states that cap but do not contradict current evidence
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Use the existing professional-domain receipt/control route; receipt binds exact process definition/instance, inputs, outputs/readbacks, review, verdict, claim ceiling, open items and reopen triggers.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: No automatic promotion. Controlled Evolution requires eligible Independent Review and authorized owner-native adoption under the existing architecture-control route.

execution_depth_contract.parity_rule: Equivalent Building Acoustics execution depth is demonstrated through source-receiver/task criteria, room/separation/noise-vibration analysis, flanking/interface detail, prediction/measurement identity, construction QA and occupied-state diagnosis rather than absorption coefficients or product ratings alone.
professional_problem_and_judgment_object: Room Acoustic Criteria / Geometry / Finish Register
option_comparison_objects: mitigation options tied to source/path/receiver consequence
independent_review_objects: independent acoustics professional review at declared claim ceiling
specialist MEP/structural/facade/FLS owners retain their technical approvals
